verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public REST API hosted at api.incident.io with API-key auth, a full API reference covering endpoints/auth/rate limits/error handling, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec for client generation, plus webhooks for event-driven integration. This gives AI-native users a documented, programmatic surface to drive the product beyond just the MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the API in practice, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s at common paths, suggesting the spec may not be trivially discoverable/self-hosted.
